name: Fane of Panjvahe
description:
The significance of oases lies in the embrace of the desert. The oasis dwellers have never been oblivious to this. Thus did the ancestors in Gurabad build the hermitage for the Lord of Desert.
Through the sandstorm-shrouded past and present, this hermitage has become an asylum for countless desert dwellers, among whom are some bandits as well...

tabs.name: Fading Rumination
tabs.description: When travelers step into this lonesome hall, the ancient mechanisms and desert bandits that have been patrolling the place will emerge from the shadows, determined to punish the reckless intruders...
